name: Bílkovice (Czechia)
description: Upper part divided vertically into red at the hoist and black at the fly, each charged with a yellow bell and separated by a yellow cross pattée, above a white embattled stripe and a narrow blue stripe near the bottom edge on a white base.
history: Czech municipal flags are granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Parliament and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.

features.role: two bells and a cross pattée
